title: e2e Raises $8M Seed Round to Build AI Software Verification Layer
summary:
A software verification startup has entered the market to address the challenges of autonomous coding by creating an open-source testing framework for AI agents. The company, which recently rebranded from TesterArmy to e2e, provides a verification layer intended to help individual developers and large enterprises ensure the reliability of software produced by artificial intelligence.

The startup secured $8M in seed funding from investors including Credo Ventures, Kaya, Point Nine Capital, Baobab Ventures, and Script Capital, with participation from Uber co-founder Oscar Salazar and Snowflake co-founder Marcin Żukowski. In its first 30 days of operation, e2e reported 1.5M npm downloads, 12k GitHub stars and the execution of 8M tests.
